mentions.author: b215826
mentions.story: Ask HN: How can a intermediate-beginner learn Unix/Linux and programming?
mentions.text:
The Missing Semester of Your CS Education [1] is a set of tutorials from MIT that gets you to speed with using the CLI, using a text editor (Vim), version controlling (using Git), basic debugging, etc.
Some tutorials aren't perfect (e.g., an earlier version had things like `for f in $(ls)` [3]), but at least they link to good tools and resources.
There's also Software Carpentry [2], which has similar goals.
You might also want to check out The Bash Guide [4,5], which is hands down the best Bash tutorial written.

[1]: [course]
